disclaimer: This audit compares tracked dependencies with synthetic acceptance expectations. It does not prove production or staging behavior, configuration, authorization, or deployment state.

statuses.covered: A synthetic expectation directly exercises the dependency and documented test-plan dimension.
statuses.partial: Expectations exercise only some operations, actors, resources, or an analogous path.
statuses.not-covered: No synthetic expectation exercises the tracked dependency.
statuses.blocked-unknown-semantics: No expectation is asserted because repository evidence does not establish required authorization or runtime semantics.
